name: app.onlyrecipes/only-recipes
title: Only Recipes
description: Save, search and import recipes, manage grocery lists and plan meals in Only Recipes.

tools.name: import_recipe
tools.description: Use this when the user pastes a recipe link (any recipe site, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest or Facebook) and wants the recipe itself. Returns clean ingredients and steps without ads. Does not add anything to the user's account; call save_recipe afterwards if they want to keep it. For recipe text pasted into the chat, use create_recipe instead.

url.description: The URL to import the recipe from

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Use this when the user wants ideas or recipes to cook, by dish, ingredient, cuisine, diet, time or rating, or just wants to browse. query is optional: leave it out to browse by tags and sort. Searches the public Only Recipes library and returns a grid of recipes. Not for the user's own recipes (use list_my_recipes) or for a pasted link (use import_recipe). Plain keywords need no filters; call get_filters first only to filter by tag. Without a linked account, query matches whole words and word prefixes in the recipe name, a short description summary and tag slugs (not arbitrary substrings), results can lag new recipes and votes by up to a day, and sourceUrl is always null.

query.description: Text search query to match recipe name or description

sort.description: Sort order: recent (newest), popular (most votes), rating (highest rated), trending (recently imported)

tools.name: find_recipe
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a recipe link and you only need to know whether Only Recipes already has it. Returns the matching recipe's id, name and page, or exists: false. Fetches nothing. To show the recipe, use import_recipe instead.

tools.name: get_filters
tools.description: Use this when you need valid tag slugs for search_recipes, for example to filter by cuisine, course, diet or occasion. Without arguments returns every category with its tags; with category returns only that category's tags. Not needed for plain keyword searches. Without a linked account, the full list covers the featured categories and only tags that have public recipes.

category.description: A category slug or id, e.g. 'cuisine' or 'diet'. Leave out to get all categories.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see or cook one specific recipe: its ingredients, steps, times and photo. Pass servings to scale every ingredient quantity. Takes an id or slug from another tool's results; for a pasted link use import_recipe. Without a linked account the recipe comes from the public recipe page's data: a few internal columns (video ids, short title, SEO title, bookmark/favorite/collection counts, site, cuisine and restaurant refs) come back null.

identifier.description: The recipe slug or ID (IDs start with 'rec_')

servings.description: Scale the ingredients to this many servings. Leave out for the recipe as written.

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Use this when one of this server's tools errored, returned wrong or incomplete results, ignored a parameter, or is missing for the user's task. Sends a report to the Only Recipes developers. Include what you called, what came back, what you expected, and a concrete proposed fix. Do not include the user's personal data. Call at most once per distinct issue.

kind.description: bug: a tool misbehaved; idea: a missing tool or parameter; question: a description is unclear

summary.description: What you tried, what you got, what you expected

tool.description: The tool the report is about

arguments.description: The arguments you passed, as JSON text, without personal data

proposedFix.description: A concrete change that would fix it

severity.description: high: the user's task could not be completed
